question: Who was the first Indian wrestler to win Gold at the World Championships in 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sushil Kumar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sushil Kumar** was the first Indian wrestler to win Gold at the World Championships in 2010.
 
• This victory was a significant milestone in Indian wrestling, marking India's presence on the global stage.
 
• Sushil Kumar's achievement inspired many young athletes in India to take up wrestling as a sport.
 
• His win at the World Championships added to his illustrious career, which includes multiple Olympic medals and other international accolades.
 
• Sushil Kumar's contribution to Indian wrestling has been recognized with numerous awards, including the prestigious Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna and the Padma Shri.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **World Wrestling Championships** is an annual event organized by the United World Wrestling (UWW).
 
• Winning a gold medal at this event is considered one of the highest achievements in the sport of wrestling.
 
• India has produced several world-class wrestlers, and Sushil Kumar is one of the most prominent figures among them.
 
• In addition to his World Championship victory, Sushil Kumar has won bronze and silver medals at the Olympics, further solidifying his legacy in the sport.
 
• His success has had a profound impact on the development of wrestling in India, leading to increased investment and interest in the sport.
